stops.name: Kanyakumari
stops.note: The southern tip and the first step.

stops.name: Nagercoil
stops.note: The first town of the walk.

stops.name: Tirunelveli
stops.note: Out of the coastal strip and onto the plain.

stops.name: Kovilpatti
stops.note: Cotton country and the long straight road north.

stops.name: Virudhunagar
stops.note: Last stop before Madurai.

stops.name: Madurai
stops.note: A detour with a reason: his first girlfriend lived here.

stops.name: Dindigul
stops.note: The hills come into view to the west.

stops.name: Karur
stops.note: Crossing the Amaravati and Kaveri.

stops.name: Namakkal
stops.note: Rock fort town on the way to Salem.

stops.name: Salem
stops.note: Walked through on purpose. His crush lives here.

stops.name: Dharmapuri
stops.note: Climbing toward the Karnataka border.

stops.name: Krishnagiri
stops.note: Where the road turns west for Bengaluru.

stops.name: Hosur
stops.note: The last Tamil Nadu town on the route.

stops.name: Bengaluru
stops.note: A confirmed major stop.

stops.name: Chikkaballapur
stops.note: Out of the city and onto the Deccan plateau.

stops.name: Anantapur
stops.note: Dry country, long days, few trees.

stops.name: Kurnool
stops.note: Crossing the Tungabhadra.

stops.name: Mahbubnagar
stops.note: Into Telangana.

stops.name: Hyderabad
stops.note: The route turns through Telangana.

stops.name: Kamareddy
stops.note: North out of the city on the Nagpur road.

stops.name: Nizamabad
stops.note: Turmeric and sugarcane country.

stops.name: Nirmal
stops.note: Toward the Godavari and the forest belt.

stops.name: Adilabad
stops.note: The last Telangana town before Maharashtra.

stops.name: Hinganghat
stops.note: Back into Maharashtra, cotton country again.

stops.name: Wardha
stops.note: Sevagram, and Gandhi's ashram, are here.

stops.name: Nagpur
stops.note: Central India checkpoint before Jabalpur and Rewa.

stops.name: Seoni
stops.note: Through the Satpura hills and Pench.

stops.name: Lakhnadon
stops.note: A small town on the long climb north.

stops.name: Jabalpur
stops.note: North-east through Madhya Pradesh.

stops.name: Sihora
stops.note: Leaving the Narmada valley.

stops.name: Katni
stops.note: A junction town on the way to Rewa.

stops.name: Maihar
stops.note: The temple on the hill is visible for miles.

stops.name: Satna
stops.note: Limestone country, close to home.

stops.name: Rewa
stops.note: Where he became an author. The reason the fourth book exists at all.

stops.name: Chakghat
stops.note: The last Madhya Pradesh town before Uttar Pradesh.

stops.name: Prayagraj
stops.note: The road reaches the Ganga corridor.

stops.name: Handia
stops.note: Following the Ganga east.

stops.name: Gyanpur
stops.note: Carpet-weaving country around Bhadohi.

stops.name: Varanasi
stops.note: Where he met the teacher who changed his life - and a girl.

stops.name: Jaunpur
stops.note: Turning north-west for Lucknow.

stops.name: Sultanpur
stops.note: On the Gomti, halfway to Lucknow.

stops.name: Lucknow
stops.note: Sponsor, friends and a major expedition stop.

stops.name: Hardoi
stops.note: North-west across the Awadh plain.

stops.name: Shahjahanpur
stops.note: Sugarcane as far as you can see.

stops.name: Bareilly
stops.note: Rohilkhand, and the first hint of the north.

stops.name: Rampur
stops.note: Toward the Ganga crossing.

stops.name: Moradabad
stops.note: Brass city on the Ramganga.

stops.name: Gajraula
stops.note: The long straight run into the Delhi plain.

stops.name: Ghaziabad
stops.note: The edge of the capital.

stops.name: Delhi
stops.note: Major northern checkpoint.

stops.name: Panipat
stops.note: Out of the city, onto the Grand Trunk Road.

stops.name: Karnal
stops.note: Wheat country.

stops.name: Kurukshetra
stops.note: Old ground, older stories.

stops.name: Ambala
stops.note: The Punjab border.

stops.name: Ludhiana
stops.note: Crossing the Sutlej.

stops.name: Jalandhar
stops.note: Doaba, between the rivers.

stops.name: Pathankot
stops.note: The mountains finally appear.

stops.name: Jammu
stops.note: Gateway to the final section.

stops.name: Udhampur
stops.note: The climb into the hills begins.

stops.name: Ramban
stops.note: The Chenab gorge.

stops.name: Banihal
stops.note: Below the pass into the valley.

stops.name: Qazigund
stops.note: The gate of Kashmir.

stops.name: Anantnag
stops.note: The valley floor at last.

stops.name: Srinagar
stops.note: The working finish at Lal Chowk.
